title: SwingAI 3D geometry
description: Camera calibrations, 3D reconstructions of one shot, and measurements derived from them. Selected by kind. World coordinates: right-handed metres, +X toward the target, +Y left of the target line, +Z up, origin at the ground projection of the ball centre at address. See docs/geometry-3d.md.

identifier.description: A shot or camera identifier. Must be usable verbatim as a directory name on every host SwingAI runs on, so the rules are Windows' — the booth is a Windows machine and a shot folder is meant to be copied between hosts, so the stricter platform sets the rule. Rejected: / \ : * ? " < > | and control characters; "." and ".."; a trailing period or space, which Windows silently strips, so "shot." and "shot" would name one directory; and the reserved DOS device names CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-COM9 and LPT1-LPT9 in any case, with or without an extension, because "nul.capture" still names the null device. These mirror the rules swingai-core's ShotId and CameraId enforce; the two sides of the seam must not disagree about what an id may be.

rfc3339DateTime.description: An RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. "2026-07-31T14:22:05.412Z" or "2026-07-31T16:22:05.412+02:00". An offset is required. The pattern is present as well as "format" because most JSON Schema validators treat "format" as an annotation unless a format checker is installed. The pattern is structural only — it cannot reject an impossible calendar date such as 2026-02-30, which the Rust implementation does.

relativePath.description: Forward-slash path relative to the directory containing this manifest, e.g. "streams/down_the_line.mkv". Host-independent: backslashes are rejected outright on every platform, which also rules out C:\..., UNC \\server\share, extended-length \\?\C:\..., and rooted \... spellings. Must not be absolute, must not name a drive, and must not escape the directory with "..".

cameraView.description: Note this differs from the Python side's "dtl" (utils/swing_pairing.py, data/annotations.json). The bridge maps; this contract does not accept the abbreviation.

matrix4.description: Row-major 4x4 rigid transform (rotation with det +1, last row 0 0 0 1). X_to = M @ X_from.

timing_uncertainty.description: Worst-case bound from timing (impact-time and exposure-timing uncertainty), in the value's unit; null when not applicable or not propagated. Kept apart from uncertainty (1-sigma from image localization).

measurement.description: measured: from observed points meeting every quality gate; inferred: depends on a point a person placed as hidden; unavailable: value is null and reasons say why. Never a guessed number.

Direction toward the target in rig coordinates, from explicit evidence (e.g. an operator-confirmed board edge along the target line). Shots may instead supply it from labelled target-line marker points.

points.description: Point names (the shot-label catalogue's), the order of the arrays' point axis.

items.description: One camera's own frame: source-frame id, its timestamp on that source's clock, and the decoded image's digest.

motion_time_ms.description: time_ms in the swing's real time (time_ms x the reference stream's motion-clock scale); null when the motion time is unknown

bound_ms.description: worst-case timing error between the views' exposures, real ms; null when a component is unknown

exposure_ms.description: exposure-midpoint term not already in sync_uncertainty_ms (0 when included); null when unknown

unknown.description: timing components that are unknown (never taken as zero)

timing.description: Dynamic frames only (null for static_address): bound_ms = motion_scale * (pair_gap_ms + sync_uncertainty_ms) + exposure_ms.

items.description: time_ms is on the reference stream's clock (its frame-0-relative timestamps); another stream's time maps as t_ref = t_stream + synchronization.offset_ms. static_address pairs each stream's own P1 frame (the golfer is still), so synchronization doesn't bear on it; dynamic frames are paired by synchronized time.

layout.description: time_ms (F), xyz (F,P,3) metres, cov (F,P,3,3) m^2, state (F,P) int8 0=missing 1=observed 2=inferred, n_views (F,P), reprojection_px (F,P,V), parallax_deg (F,P); timing: motion_time_ms (F) real ms, timing_bound_ms (F) real ms, speed_bound_m_s (P), timing_error_m (F,P) worst-case displacement between exposures (kept apart from cov), timing_status (F,P) int8 0=not applicable 1=within 2=exceeds 3=unknown. sha256 of each array's C-order bytes, so the content is checkable whatever the zip container's metadata.

impact_time_uncertainty_ms.description: Real ms. P7 marks the frame containing or nearest impact, so impact lies within one frame interval of it; nothing finer is claimed.
